key_findings: Single woman in her early 40s with UC pancolitis (1999) and large-duct PSC (2022); rectosigmoid stricture biopsied and dilated without dysplasia; laparoscopic total proctocolectomy with end ileostomy in early 2024; rectal endometriosis confirmed by ER immunohistochemistry; recovering well at follow-up.

NO-BORROWING warnings on p1-f056/f057 are checker false positives: 'Disease activity at time of colonoscopy showed' is the lead clause of the same sentence that lists all three segment scores, so it scopes them; quotes are exact.

CRP 6.9 mg/L printed with N <5 mg/L inside results called unremarkable: individual lab flags left unknown, aggregate flag normal, recorded as an ambiguity (not a source conflict, since the source never classifies CRP as high).
Abstract 'total colectomy' vs body 'total proctocolectomy' kept as an ambiguity; malignancy kept as possible (oncology assertion possible); annual screening care plan status unknown.
UCEIS kept in observations as endoscopic procedure findings (SECTION-IMAGING), not a symptom or functional scale.
